title: AI Project Coordinator
description:
AI Project Coordinator

  • Salary: £30,000–£45,000 plus company bonus scheme
  • Job Type: Full-time, permanent
  • Working Arrangement: Remote working with travel to client sites approximately 30–40% of the time

Role Overview:

  • Join a growing AI consultancy, working closely with senior consultants to coordinate client engagements and ensure projects, commitments and deliverables remain on track.
  • Act as the link between clients and consultants, ensuring everyone understands their responsibilities, actions and deadlines.
  • Take ownership of coordinating projects, maintaining documentation and following up on agreed actions.
  • Support clients with their AI adoption, including basic training and helping them understand and use AI tools and agents.
  • Join a growing business with the opportunity to develop your skills, take on more responsibility and progress as the consultancy expands.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate client projects and engagements, keeping activities, milestones and deadlines on track.
  • Liaise with clients and consultants to ensure commitments are met and agreed actions are completed in line with pre-agreed deadlines.
  • Monitor progress, follow up on outstanding tasks and proactively address delays or issues.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, records, meeting notes and action logs.
  • Organise meetings, coordinate diaries and ensure the right people are involved at the right time.
  • Keep clients informed of progress and ensure they understand their responsibilities and next steps.
  • Support senior consultants by ensuring deliverables are completed and client engagements run smoothly.
  • Visit client sites to support engagements, build relationships and help clients progress their AI initiatives.
  • Assist with basic AI training and help clients understand how to use AI tools and build AI agents.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, coordination and the overall client experience.

About You:

  • Organised, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of tasks without needing close supervision.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to liaise directly with clients and consultants.
  • Able to manage multiple activities, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented, with the ability to keep documentation accurate and ensure actions are followed through.
  • Technically savvy, with a genuine interest in AI, technology and how they can be applied in business.
  • Interested in learning about AI tools, agents and their practical applications, with the confidence to support clients as your knowledge develops.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with a small team.
  • Willing and able to travel to client sites approximately 30–40% of the time.
  • Looking for a permanent position with the ambition to develop and grow with a fast-growing business.

The Opportunity:

  • A full-time, permanent position within a growing AI consultancy.
  • Salary of £30,000–£45,000 plus a company bonus scheme.
  • Exposure to AI consultancy, client delivery and practical AI adoption.
  • The opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, broaden your responsibilities and build a long-term career as the business grows.
